parameters.content:
## AI Integrated Conversation — Development
POST /webhook/restaurant-dev/ai-integrated

Request: {whatsAppId, text, messageId?}

This workflow:
1. Validates input and creates/gets customer session
2. Calls Groq for intent classification
3. Routes to appropriate handler (greeting, menu, order, cart, checkout, status, handoff)
4. Calls backend APIs for real data
5. Returns formatted response

Intents: greeting, menu, order, cart_view, cart_clear, checkout, order_status, handoff, fallback
